## Summary
Seed the complete USMLE Step 1 taxonomy into Neo4j: 18 organ systems as USMLE_System nodes, ~100 topics as USMLE_Topic nodes, and ~400 subtopics as USMLE_Subtopic nodes, with HAS_TOPIC and HAS_SUBTOPIC edges forming the three-level hierarchy.

## User story
As a content pipeline, I need the full USMLE taxonomy in the knowledge graph, so that every AssessmentItem can be linked to its USMLE_Subtopic hub (the assessment hub in the Three-Hub Invariant).

## Why this matters
USMLE_Subtopic is one of the three mandatory hubs (D06 — Three-Hub Invariant). Without it, no AssessmentItem can enter the practice pool. The taxonomy hierarchy also drives coverage analytics, gap detection, and exam blueprint alignment. Incorrect or incomplete taxonomy means items are orphaned from the assessment dimension.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 18 USMLE_System nodes created (e.g., Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Nervous, etc.)
- [ ] ~100 USMLE_Topic nodes created, each linked to its parent system via HAS_TOPIC
- [ ] ~400 USMLE_Subtopic nodes created, each linked to its parent topic via HAS_SUBTOPIC
- [ ] All nodes carry institution_id for tenant isolation (Rule 1)
- [ ] All nodes carry uuid, name, and code properties
- [ ] Seed is idempotent (MERGE on name + institution_id)
- [ ] Script uses neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)
- [ ] Hierarchy is validated: every USMLE_Subtopic has exactly one parent USMLE_Topic, every USMLE_Topic has exactly one parent USMLE_System

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | All Neo4j writes use neo4jQuery — wrapper injects institution_id |
| Three-Hub Invariant (D06) | USMLE_Subtopic is the assessment hub — must be complete and correct |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// scripts/seeds/05-usmle-taxonomy.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const USMLE_SYSTEMS = [
  { code: 'CVS', name: 'Cardiovascular System' },
  { code: 'RESP', name: 'Respiratory System' },
  { code: 'NERV', name: 'Nervous System' },
  // ... 18 total
]

async function seedUSMLETaxonomy(institutionId: string) {
  // 1. Seed systems
  for (const system of USMLE_SYSTEMS) {
    await neo4jQuery(
      `MERGE (s:USMLE_System {code: $code, institution_id: $institution_id})
       ON CREATE SET s.uuid = randomUUID(), s.name = $name, s.created_at = datetime()
       ON MATCH SET s.name = $name, s.updated_at = datetime()`,
      { code: system.code, name: system.name },
      institutionId
    )
  }

  // 2. Seed topics with HAS_TOPIC edges
  for (const topic of USMLE_TOPICS) {
    await neo4jQuery(
      `MATCH (s:USMLE_System {code: $system_code, institution_id: $institution_id})
       MERGE (t:USMLE_Topic {code: $code, institution_id: $institution_id})
       ON CREATE SET t.uuid = randomUUID(), t.name = $name, t.system_code = $system_code, t.created_at = datetime()
       ON MATCH SET t.name = $name, t.updated_at = datetime()
       MERGE (s)-[:HAS_TOPIC]->(t)`,
      { code: topic.code, name: topic.name, system_code: topic.system_code },
      institutionId
    )
  }

  // 3. Seed subtopics with HAS_SUBTOPIC edges
  // ... same MERGE pattern
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import neo4j from 'neo4j-driver'  // BANNED

// ✗ CREATE instead of MERGE — duplicates on re-run
await neo4jQuery('CREATE (s:USMLE_System {name: $name})', ...)  // WRONG

// ✗ Orphaned subtopics without parent edge
// Every USMLE_Subtopic MUST have a HAS_SUBTOPIC edge from its parent USMLE_Topic
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S05.seed.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const TEST_INSTITUTION = process.env.TEST_INSTITUTION_ID ?? 'test-institution-001'

test('Acceptance: 18 USMLE_System nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (s:USMLE_System {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(s) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBe(18)
})

test('Acceptance: ~100 USMLE_Topic nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (t:USMLE_Topic {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(t) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(90)
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeLessThanOrEqual(120)
})

test('Acceptance: ~400 USMLE_Subtopic nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (st:USMLE_Subtopic {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(st) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(350)
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBeLessThanOrEqual(450)
})

test('Acceptance: every topic has exactly one parent system', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (t:USMLE_Topic {institution_id: $institution_id})
     OPTIONAL MATCH (s:USMLE_System)-[:HAS_TOPIC]->(t)
     WITH t, count(s) as parentCount
     WHERE parentCount <> 1
     RETURN count(t) as orphans`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
})

test('Acceptance: every subtopic has exactly one parent topic', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (st:USMLE_Subtopic {institution_id: $institution_id})
     OPTIONAL MATCH (t:USMLE_Topic)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(st)
     WITH st, count(t) as parentCount
     WHERE parentCount <> 1
     RETURN count(st) as orphans`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
})

test('Acceptance: all nodes have institution_id', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (n {institution_id: $institution_id})
     WHERE (n:USMLE_System OR n:USMLE_Topic OR n:USMLE_Subtopic)
       AND n.institution_id IS NULL
     RETURN count(n) as orphans`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  if (result) {
    expect(result.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
  }
})

test('Acceptance: seed is idempotent', async () => {
  const before = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (s:USMLE_System {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(s) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  execSync('pnpm tsx scripts/seeds/05-usmle-taxonomy.ts')
  const after = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (s:USMLE_System {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(s) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(before!.records[0].count).toBe(after!.records[0].count)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Remove all USMLE nodes:
   ```cypher
   MATCH (n) WHERE n:USMLE_System OR n:USMLE_Topic OR n:USMLE_Subtopic DETACH DELETE n
   ```
2. `git stash && git checkout develop`
